grades.lower_bound_mechanism: geometric division (2^n:...:1) + even-position majorization induction (Lemma E)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: subset-sum pigeonhole gap ≤ 1/N + supply–demand pairing/cancellation with cut count
grades.notes: Complete proof. Lemma 1 proves the odd-sum reduction with explicit pairing strategies for both players. Theorem A proves the all-n lower bound via even-position majorization on the geometric division. Theorem B proves the all-n upper bound via pigeonhole plus cancellation, with cut counts and degenerate cases (D1, D2) correctly handled.
